scientific_integrity: Both endpoint expansions are derived from the exact two-exponential maximum cdfs. Tail derivative statements are obtained from exact implicit derivative identities rather than by formally differentiating a little-o term. Numerical replay is supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to two components, strict hazard ordering, and equal hazard sums. It proves endpoint curvature signs and at least one inflection, not uniqueness of the inflection point. Equivalent endpoint expansions under unrelated quantile-transform terminology remain a bibliographic possibility.
title: Endpoint curvature law for heterogeneous exponential parallel systems
